Dana

subject: FW: P1 membrane - two quotes, they don't agree
body:
Priya,

Both inspection quotes for the P1 membrane are in, forwarding below. Short version: Rideau says $42k for a standard recoat and saw nothing structural. Capital came in at $51k and flagged staining they think could mean slab deterioration underneath - they want a structural engineer to look before anyone recoats anything.

The two reports genuinely disagree, so I think this has to go to the board in May rather than me just picking one.

Dana

subject: Inspection Report - P1 Membrane, Maple Court
body:
Dear Ms. Whitfield,

Following our April 16 site visit we have completed our inspection of the same P1 membrane area. Our quotation is $51,000, breakdown attached.

Please note: we observed staining consistent with possible slab deterioration beneath the membrane. This is outside a membrane contractor's scope to confirm either way. We recommend a structural engineer confirm the slab condition before any recoat proceeds. We would rather flag this now than have you discover it under a fresh membrane.

Sylvie Tran
Capital Membrane Ltd.

subject: Spring Cleanup Schedule
body:
Hi Dana,

Confirming spring cleanup for Maple Court the week of May 1st. Crew of four, two days. Please let us know if there are any specific areas of focus this year, otherwise we'll follow last season's scope.

GreenScape crew

subject: RE: 312 / 808 - second notices
body:
Second notices went out to both 312 and 808 today, registered mail this time. Still nothing back from the first round. 312's March and April are now both outstanding, 808 the same. Will include totals in the month-end summary.

Accounting

subject: P1 Garage Membrane Inspection Quote
body:
Hi Dana,

We inspected the P1 garage membrane on Thursday following the March leak. The membrane is at end of life in the affected area and we quote $42,000 for a standard recoat of the full P1 level, mobilization included. No structural concerns noted from our visual inspection - this is normal wear for a membrane of this age.

We could schedule for June. Quote valid 60 days.

Gord Belanger
Rideau Roofing

subject: RE: EV Charger Request
body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for the formal request. Honest answer: the corporation doesn't have forms or a process for this yet, yours is the first. I don't want to hold you up with an invented answer, so I'm putting it in front of the board at the May meeting to get a proper policy direction. I'll come back to you right after.

Dana

subject: RE: Reserve Fund Study Renewal
body:
Thank you Marc. I'll take the renewal offer to the board at the May meeting and confirm after. Appreciate you holding the rate.

Dana

subject: EV Charger Request
body:
Hi Dana,

Following up on my note from last month - I went ahead and ordered the car, delivery in June. I'd like to formally request approval to install a Level 2 EV charger in my parking space (P2-14). My electrician says it's straightforward from the panel on that level.

Please let me know the required forms or process, happy to fill in whatever is needed.

Sam

subject: Reserve Fund Study Renewal
body:
Dear Dana,

Our records show the Maple Court reserve fund study is now three years old and an update is due this fiscal year. As the firm that prepared the last cycle, we are pleased to offer the update at last cycle's rate, $6,800, if engaged before fiscal year end.

Happy to discuss scope. We hold the building's full component inventory from last time, which shortens the work considerably.

Marc Aubin, P.Eng.
Cardinal Engineering

subject: RE: FOURTH complaint - unit 511
body:
Helen,

I hear you, and you're right that this has gone on too long. I've been unable to reach the owner of 511 by phone or mail since March. I'm escalating this to the board at the May meeting as a compliance matter so they can decide on formal steps. I'll keep you posted on the outcome.

Dana

subject: FOURTH complaint - unit 511
body:
Dana,

This is my fourth complaint since February about late-night noise and the constant turnover at Unit 511. Different people every weekend, suitcases in the hallway at 1am, and last night the music went until past 2 again. I strongly suspect it's being used as a short-term rental. I've been patient but this is affecting my sleep and my work.

Can management please look into this properly? What are my options if this continues?

Helen Moss
Unit 504

Maple Court (OCSCC 742, 88 units) has an active leak through the P1 garage membrane near spot 41, first reported March 9 and worse since the thaw. We'd like an inspection and a quotation for remediation from each of you. Access via the ramp off Maple Court Lane; I can meet you on site any weekday.
